name: Halisite
description: The Halisite were a sentient species that originated on a planet on the frontier and were considered rare by the time of the High Republic Era. They possessed a bone fin that crested their head and pulsed red and blue as it flushed with blood in time with their heartbeat. One Halisite, Quith Meglar, was a member of the Nihil marauders who wished to defect.
